notes.title: [Hotfix] 0.4.13
notes.notes:
[h1]Overall: [/h1]
"Animations are giving me a headache, so I'm still working on the head boobing thing, as I just came 4 days ago home, but I've taken your suggestions and added and fixed a lot of things. This is a small patch, focused on your suggestions however and the Unity 5.3 as they improved the engine performance, so while it might seem as a big update its mostly because of the Unity update."

[Added] Mouse Sensitivity - Suggestion: Stefan8000 
[Added] Even less Sanity drain
[Added] Less Battery drain
[Added] More vision to the player, in full darkness
[Fixed] Issues with the menu
[Fixed] Some Memory issues
[Fixed] Main Menu not being able to click at some points

[h1]Trading Cards:[/h1]
I know a few people suggested them, and like I said I will create them but I'm working on understanding the system of it, and doing my best to be as fast as possible. I know, it should have been done, and its me to blame, but I just beg a bit of patience, as there is a lot of work around me.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Hotfix] 0.4.12
notes.notes:
We listened to your feedback and made some improvements on both the Sanity and the Flashlight, giving flashlight the ability so self-recharge when extremely low, and reducing the recharge as more battery it has.

Also we added more ambient light to the player, so if even you don't have a flashlight, you can still see things in the dark ;)

[Completed] Improve flashlight battery
[Completed] Improve Sanity fast draining (decreased the sanity drain by 340%)
[Completed] Added more head space (looking down and up) again.
[Completed] Fixed flashlight going up too soon. (reduced the trigger)
[Completed] Stop sanity decaying while reading notes
[Completed] Slow recharge on flashlight while not using 
[Completed] Added more light when everything is dark
[WIP] Head bobbing fix (still needs research)

notes.title: Mac and Linux version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, the Demented world is currently limited to Windows only, and I'm here to discuss other OS platforms. 

[h1]Is there a plan for Mac and Linux?[/h1]

Yes there is. It just needs some time, as I also need to figure out about how to publish these to onto Steam, as well as some performance tricks I need to manage to make everything working smoothly.

I'm not giving any dates, however these versions can be expected a few weeks after the initial release.

Thank you, cheers! ːsteamsaltyː
